venues.name: Lantana Shoreditch
venues.addr: 2 Oliver's Yard, 55 City Road, London EC1Y 1HQ
venues.cap: Up to 150 standing / 60 seated (exclusive hire); Mural Zone 50 standing / 40 seated
venues.note: Cafe-by-day with a dedicated private-hire page that publishes capacity bands and minimum spends, a covered outdoor terrace and explicit networking/team-social positioning — the room shape, coffee service and 150-guest band are an exact match for a 50-200-person Tech Week coffee/hack day one minute from Old St roundabout.
venues.alt: Lantana Shoreditch semi-private event zone with warm timber, mural wall and cafe seating

venues.name: The Cafe Venue (Proper Office, 2 Bath Place)
venues.addr: 2 Bath Place, London EC2A 3DR (Shoreditch, 4 min from Old St)
venues.linkText: Cafe-Style Venue Hire in Shoreditch — Proper Office
venues.note: Purpose-built cafe-style event space with booth seating, communal tables, unlimited tea/coffee included and an on-site reception team — explicitly pitched at networking events, workshops and company socials, 4 min from Old St, fits the 50-100-person end of the hack-day brief perfectly.
venues.alt: Communal cafe-style event space at The Cafe Venue with booth seating, lounge areas and natural light

venues.name: Ozone Coffee Roasters Shoreditch
venues.addr: 11 Leonard St, London EC2A 4AQ (next to Old Street station)
venues.cap: Private meeting room (est. ~30-50) + larger private-dining / whole-venue hire on enquiry — see brochure (est)
venues.linkText: Private Hire at Ozone Coffee Shoreditch
venues.note: Working specialty coffee roastery two minutes from Old St roundabout with a dedicated private-hire page, an explicit meeting-room hire tier (£10/person/hr including unlimited specialty coffee) and a private-hire brochure for larger bookings — the room is a proven builder/freelancer haunt on weekdays, good for a coffee-led hack-day breakout wave.
venues.alt: Ozone Coffee Roasters Shoreditch — brick exterior and wide industrial cafe interior with baristas

venues.name: Potter & Reid
venues.addr: 20-22 Toynbee Street, London E1 7NE (Spitalfields, 10 min from Old St)
venues.linkText: Catering & Private Venue Hire — Potter & Reid
venues.note: Tour-trace seed: Potter & Reid hosted Cafe Cursor London in Dec 2025 (Cursor founders took over the cafe with a laptop-crowd co-working day, two slots 9am-1pm / 1pm-5pm) — the room is proven to say yes to a coffee takeover for AI builders at our exact event shape, across two rooms with a marble counter, natural-wine fridges and pavement tables.
venues.alt: Potter & Reid cafe interior on Toynbee Street with marble counter, dark wood and warm lighting

venues.name: Attendant Shoreditch
venues.addr: 5 Ravey Street, London EC2A 4QP (Shoreditch, 6 min from Old St)
venues.cap: Whole-venue hire (est. ~80-120 standing via Hirespace/Headbox listings)
venues.note: Small-batch coffee roasters' Shoreditch outpost on a quiet Victorian back street of Old St with industrial-chic interiors, a living-wall breakout and a biophilic feel — listed for whole-venue private hire through Hirespace/Headbox with networking-reception and morning-breakfast layouts, so the booking route runs through those marketplaces rather than a dedicated on-site events page.
venues.alt: Attendant Shoreditch rustic-industrial cafe interior with living wall and counter

venues.name: Shoreditch Grind
venues.addr: 213 Old Street, London EC1V 9NR (Old Street roundabout)
venues.cap: Up to 50 guests (full venue hire, published)
venues.note: The original Grind coffee bar on Old St roundabout — cylindrical black building that's a Silicon Roundabout landmark — with a dedicated venue-hire page that publishes a 50-guest cap, evening license until midnight and an all-day coffee-to-cocktail format, good for the lower end of the hack-day brief or a side-event espresso-martini reception.
venues.alt: Shoreditch Grind interior with white marble counters and bar stools on Old Street

venues.name: Second Home Spitalfields - The Auditorium
venues.note: Iconic cowork-native venue 5 min from Shoreditch High St and Liverpool St; purpose-built for panel talks, conferences, hack days and launches with stage, PA and plug-and-play AV. Selgas Cano-designed biophilic space reads perfectly for a bilingual tech-week crowd.
venues.alt: Tiered auditorium with warm lighting and the iconic Flying Table inside Second Home Spitalfields

venues.name: The Trampery Old Street - The Ballroom
venues.note: Flagship innovation hub right on Silicon Roundabout with a 200-person Ballroom, natural light and custom acoustic treatment; Trampery explicitly lists hackdays among events hosted. B-Corp with in-house catering and AV.
venues.alt: The Ballroom at The Trampery Old Street set theatre-style with abundant natural light

venues.name: Techspace Goswell Road - The Gallery
venues.note: Home of the London AI Hub, 10 min walk from Old Street; double-height gallery with 105in screen, 1Gbps WiFi both directions and stage lighting made for tech conferences and hybrid streams. Dry hire with dedicated events team.
venues.alt: Double-height, skylight-flooded interior of The Gallery at Techspace Goswell Road

venues.name: Rich Mix - The Mix
venues.addr: 35-47 Bethnal Green Road, Shoreditch, London E1 6LA
venues.note: Five-storey arts landmark moments from Brick Lane with a 200-cap modern conference room, three cinema screens for demos, and an events team that has staged SXSW and Netflix. Independent charity, so hire fees support the local creative community.
venues.alt: The Mix event room at Rich Mix with high ceilings, high tables and ambient blue lighting

venues.name: Village Underground
venues.note: Victorian brick warehouse 2 min from Shoreditch High St with state-of-the-art sound and lighting, natural daylight and a late licence; explicit conferences-and-meetings hire track. Scales comfortably past 200 if the bilingual tech week grows.
venues.alt: Wide stripped-back main space at Village Underground set up for a conference

venues.name: Liverpool Street Grind
venues.note: Buzzing espresso bar + all-day restaurant right outside Liverpool Street, open til 1am. Best pick for a 100+ coffee-week hack day that wants to blend into evening networking by Broadgate Circle.
venues.alt: Liverpool Street Grind interior at Broadgate Circle

venues.name: The Café Venue (Proper Office, Shoreditch)
venues.note: Purpose-built cafe-style networking space (1,200 sq ft) four minutes from Old Street, fully stocked kitchen + unlimited coffee/tea included. Solid mid-size venue hire for a 50-100 person daytime hack sprint.
venues.alt: The Café Venue lounge seating, Shoreditch

venues.name: Second Home Spitalfields
venues.note: Iconic biophilic coworking house in the heart of Spitalfields' creative-tech corridor with seven bookable event spaces (Auditorium, Rooftop, Cafe) 5 min from Liverpool St and Brick Lane — a natural home for a hack day.
venues.alt: Second Home Spitalfields interior coworking space with abundant greenery and natural light

venues.name: wallacespace spitalfields
venues.note: Purpose-built training/event space with a rooftop kitchen (cap 150) and combinable rooms up to 220; all-inclusive day-delegate model and a direct events email make it very hack-day friendly.
venues.alt: wallacespace spitalfields combined apollo and soyuz event room in cabaret layout

venues.name: FORA - Folgate Street (The Conservatory)
venues.note: Design-led coworking campus with tiered seating, nine-metre skylights and a video wall in The Conservatory, plus garden and wrap-around terrace — very strong tech-week aesthetic 8 min from Liverpool St.
venues.alt: FORA Folgate Street Conservatory event space with tiered seating and large skylights

venues.name: The Aldgate Centre
venues.addr: Aldgate High Street, London EC3N 1AB (Aldgate station)
venues.note: Bright, accessible, eco-friendly dry-hire hall with moveable acoustic walls and superfast Wi-Fi, right next to Aldgate station — a budget-friendly, flexible blank canvas for a community hack day.
venues.alt: The Aldgate Centre open-plan event hall with natural light

venues.name: Events @ No 6 (Royal College of Pathologists)
venues.note: Award-winning modern conference venue over nine rooms plus an open-air top-floor terrace with City views, a short walk from Aldgate East; in-house AV and a dedicated events team suit a polished bilingual tech-week day.
venues.alt: Events @ No 6 flexible event space with views over the City of London skyline

venues.name: Christ Church Spitalfields (The Spitalfields Venue)
venues.note: Hawksmoor Grade-I listed landmark turned blank-canvas event venue with in-house AV, Wi-Fi and wheelchair access — a striking, high-capacity Spitalfields backdrop that scales easily to a 200-person tech-week reception.
venues.alt: Christ Church Spitalfields Nave event space with white columns and vaulted ceiling

venues.name: WatchHouse Fitzrovia
venues.cap: ~100-150 (est, multiple floors inc. basement and outdoor terrace)
venues.note: The newest and largest WatchHouse branch sits dead-centre in Fitzrovia — a Kandinsky-inspired, design-led flagship with specialty coffee, brunch and multi-level seating. The brand runs a formal private-hire programme across Houses via a single events email, making a bilingual tech-week hack day easy to book. Steps from Goodge Street and Tottenham Court Road tube for the three London tech clusters to converge on.
venues.alt: Kandinsky-inspired circular column and sleek counters inside WatchHouse Fitzrovia on Wells St

venues.name: Caravan Fitzrovia
venues.cap: Full venue up to 150; Record Room up to 50 (private); Bolsover up to 34 (semi-private)
venues.note: Specialty coffee roastery plus all-day restaurant in the former BBC Radio 1 HQ on Great Portland St. Whole-venue hire up to 150 makes it one of the few Fitzrovia coffee venues big enough for a 200-person hack-day hand-off; the lower-ground Record Room (ex-BBC studio, with AV screen and PA) is a built-in break-out / demo space.
venues.alt: Wide dining-room and bar of Caravan Fitzrovia on Great Portland Street

venues.name: Riding House Fitzrovia
venues.cap: Whole venue up to 165; Dining Room private for 55; Lounge up to 25; Stables 14
venues.note: Iconic all-day café-restaurant on Great Titchfield Street right in the heart of Fitzrovia. The dedicated events page offers whole-venue hire to 165, plus the large private Dining Room (55) and the Stables snug for speakers and sponsors. A long-time morning fixture of Fitzrovia's creative/tech workers.
venues.alt: Riding House Café Fitzrovia branded stamp and interior

venues.name: Attendant Fitzrovia
venues.cap: Up to ~30 reception (est, single room) — best for press/kick-off pods
venues.note: London's best-known converted-Victorian-restroom specialty café, two streets off Great Portland St and playground-adjacent to BBC Broadcasting House. The venue is small but Gotham-grade photogenic for an affiliated soirée; evening-only private hire 19:00-23:30 published on the events page.
venues.alt: Wide interior hallway of Attendant Fitzrovia on Foley Street

venues.name: Grind Soho
venues.cap: Up to 30 (in-house page); up to 50 standing in basement per headbox listing
venues.note: B-Corp specialty coffee + cocktail bar in the heart of Soho, two blocks off Brewer St. Whole-venue private hire via dedicated Grind page gives a turnkey hack-day wrap-up venue immediately after sessions elsewhere; cocktail / espresso martini programme makes it a natural tech-week after-hours anchor.
venues.alt: Coffee shop and cocktail bar interior of Grind Soho on Beak Street

venues.name: Honey & Co. Studio
venues.note: Honey & Co's deli + creative events space just south of Fitzrovia across the street from their flagship restaurant. Mornings are light-filled with deli and café culture; afternoons convert to a dedicated events room with sound system and bar counter. A roomy option in the Fitzrovia/Bloomsbury triangle when direct W1D/W1T cafes are full.
venues.alt: Honey & Co Studio light-filled interior events space

venues.name: Fora Broadwick Street (The Hideaway)
venues.cap: 150 standing / 100 theatre / 50 cabaret (published; whole venue up to 220 per Fora workspace page)
venues.alt: The Hideaway event space at Fora Broadwick Street, Soho — wide interior with bar and lounge seating
venues.note: Purpose-built subterranean event venue ('The Hideaway') beneath a Soho coworking hub, with reception area, bar, modular extensions and theatre/cabaret layouts — dead centre of Soho, 6 min from Oxford Circus and Tottenham Court Road. Biggest confirmed capacity in the postcode band and a dedicated events team; natural fit for a 50-200-person tech-week coffee/hack day.

venues.name: Mortimer House by Maslow's (Loft & Gallery)
venues.cap: 120 standing / 70 theatre (published, Loft & Gallery); whole house up to 300 across 5 spaces
venues.alt: Loft & Gallery penthouse event space at Mortimer House, Fitzrovia — light-filled wide interior
venues.note: Members-club coworking house in the heart of Fitzrovia with a light-filled penthouse Loft & Gallery (rooftop terrace attached, in-house catering, late licence). Regularly hired for talks, presentations and standing receptions; flexible layouts suit an all-day bilingual coffee/hack format, and the rooftop adds breakout air.

venues.name: 1 Warwick by Maslow's (Nolita Social / Library & Drawing Room / Yasmin)
venues.cap: 100 standing (Yasmin exclusive hire) / 80 standing (Library & Drawing Room) (published)
venues.alt: Library and Drawing Room at 1 Warwick members house, Soho — wide lounge interior
venues.note: Sister Maslow's house on the Soho/Fitzrovia border: Library + Drawing Room (80 standing, DJ setup, bar) and the Yasmin floor with semi-private rooftop terrace (100 standing) give a built-in coffee-bar plus room for hacking clusters. Same dedicated events page/team as Mortimer House — good overflow or alternate date option.

venues.name: Soho Works Dean Street
venues.cap: 10-120 across 8 bookable meeting/event spaces (published range on Soho House event-spaces page)
venues.linkText: Soho Works Dean Street — meeting & event spaces
venues.alt: Soho Works Dean Street — lounge-style coworking floors in an 18th-century Soho block
venues.note: Soho House's work arm on Dean Street (W1D) — non-members can book, so no membership gate for a public tech-week day. Eight lounge/boardroom-style rooms across four floors (10-120) with in-house catering and podcast studio; cluster of rooms lets you run bilingual tracks plus coffee service from the members' kitchen.

venues.name: Huckletree Soho (Elwood Cafe / Ellwood Gallery)
venues.addr: Ingestre Court, Ingestre Place, Soho, London W1F 0JL
venues.cap: 50 standing / 20 seated (Elwood Cafe, Huckletree site: evenings & weekends only); third-party listings cite ~80 standing for Ellwood Gallery (~est)
venues.linkText: Huckletree London event spaces (Elwood Cafe, Soho)
venues.alt: Elwood Cafe inside Huckletree Soho, Ingestre Court — wide cafe/breakout interior
venues.note: Tech-native coworking hub by Carnaby Street with an in-house cafe (Elwood) that converts to an evening/weekend event space — literally built around coffee. Smaller confirmed capacity (50) makes it best for the 50-80 end, or as an evening demo/social slot within a tech-week programme.

venues.name: Huckletree Oxford Circus (The Parlour)
venues.cap: 80 standing / 40 seated (published on Huckletree London event-spaces page)
venues.linkText: Huckletree London event spaces (The Parlour, Oxford Circus)
venues.alt: Huckletree Oxford Circus 'The Parlour' event space — wide lounge interior above Oxford Street
venues.note: Huckletree's Web3/tech-curated hub literally in W1D (213 Oxford St), one minute from Oxford Circus. The Parlour (80 standing) plus sun terrace gives a compact but perfectly located option for a 50-100-person hack/coffee day; same events team and email as the Soho hub.

closures: Look mum no hands! — the iconic cycle-cafe at 49 Old Street EC1V 9HX, a natural fit for a Silicon Roundabout tech coffee day (Square Mile coffee, hosted cycling/tech talks and live events). Permanently closed in Feb 2023 after 13 years; both cafe and workshop shutdown announced on Instagram ('Both our cafe and our workshop are permanently closed.'). road.cc reported rising costs + post-Covid commuter drop as the cause.

Black Sheep Coffee 'Private Events' page mismatch — blacksheepcoffee.com/pages/private-events loads but is a US (South St. Paul, MN) page, not the UK chain's. Black Sheep UK runs venue hire through Tagvenue/Headbox listings (Principal Place, Regent's Place, Coleman). No on-site UK private-events URL was fetchable, so the venue was kept off the final list per the 'only output URLs you fetched' rule.

Ozone Coffee Shoreditch (11 Leonard St) — checked https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/private-hire-shoreditch-eatery; private hire is a meeting room for ~8-20 people, below the 50-person floor, so excluded (not a closure, a capacity reject).

Techspace 'The Loading Bay' Shoreditch (25 Luke St) — its own events page (fetched https://www.techspace.co/locations/shoreditch/events) states 'Under construction, booking from September 2026', making availability unverified for Sep 15 2026; substituted with the live Techspace Goswell Road Gallery page instead.
No permanent venue closures found in this search.
Kaffeine (Fitzrovia) - outside the E1/EC2A target zone so not shortlisted
Ozone Coffee London Fields (Emma St, E2 9AP) - real and still trading but falls into the London Fields/Hackney cluster rather than Spitalfields/Aldgate East, so excluded from this scout

Square Mile Coffee Roasters (Bethnal Green, E2) - excellent coffee event space with SCA campus venue hire, but located at 350 Pritchards Road E2 9AP in Bethnal Green/London Fields, not the Spitalfields/Aldgate East zone, so excluded from this scout
Second Home Spitalfields (68 Hanbury St, E1 5JL) - live and bookable but it's a design coworking space with cafes inside, not a dedicated coffee venue, so deprioritised for the 'coffee' type
Cafe 1001 (Old Truman Brewery, Dray Walk E1 6QL) - live and at the right address but is now a listening bar / late-night event space rather than a coffee-first venue, so excluded
Lady Dinah's Cat Emporium, Bethnal Green - permanently closed 2023; not included
Workshop Coffee Fitzrovia (Mortimer St) — flagship cafe was formerly on Clerkenwell Rd but is small (~15-seat front room); not a fit for 50-200 capacity coffee/hack day — excluded.
Notes Coffee Roasters & Bars — has /bookings page but all sites are Bank, Moorgate, Kings Cross, Trafalgar Sq, St Paul's, Canary Wharf, Gherkin, Reading; no W1D/W1T Fitzrovia/Soho site — excluded.
Soho House / Kettner's / Dean Street Townhouse — member-only or small-capacity (12-80) and not a coffee venue type — excluded.

Kiss the Hippo Fitzrovia (51 Margaret St W1W 8SG) and Fitzrovia Corner (36 Berners St W1T 3LY) — flagship cafes but no published private-hire events page for venues of 50+; not surfaced as event-friendly.

Second Home London Fields and Clerkenwell Green — closed after Second Home's Dec 2024 administration/buyout; only Spitalfields (E1) and Holland Park survive in London, both outside Soho/Fitzrovia (sifted.eu, Jan 2025).
Soho House 76 Dean Street (W1D 3SQ) — open, but private events are MEMBER-ONLY booking (capacity 12-80), so excluded from a public tech-week shortlist.

Work.Life Soho (W1F 8GQ) and Work.Life Fitzrovia (33 Foley St, W1W 7TL) — open, but only meeting rooms (max ~20) at these two sites; no in-area event space (their London event venues are Farringdon/London Bridge only), so excluded.
The Conduit — not closed: reopened on Langley Street, Covent Garden (out of Soho/Fitzrovia area), so excluded on geography.

neighborhoods.name: Shoreditch / Old Street (Silicon Roundabout)
neighborhoods.rationale: Google opened its AI Playground in Shoreditch in Q1 2025; the London AI Hub anchored at Techspace Goswell Road (EC1V) since Feb 2025 has hosted 1000+ attendees alongside Anthropic and Entrepreneurs First; the Claude Cyber Meetup took over Granola at 346 Old Street in Sept 2026; Encode Club runs Web3/AI hackathons minutes from Silicon Roundabout.
avoid_too: Barbican corporate conference halls — too corporate for cafe hacking
Weekend club/bar venues on Curtain Road — too loud, tiny, no daylight
Members-only hot-desking floors — hard to book for 50+ public drop-ins

neighborhoods.name: Spitalfields / Aldgate East (E1 / EC2A)
neighborhoods.rationale: Cursor AI's official Cafe Cursor pop-up drew 400+ builders to Potter & Reid on Toynbee Street in Dec 2025; LondonJP.dev — the Japanese-English bilingual dev meetup — held its Autumn 2025 Tech Talk at Artizan Street Library & Community Centre (E1 7AF) before moving to The Alice for networking; CreativeMornings/London ran its Jan 2025 breakfast at Vorboss in Exchange Square (EC2A); Techspace backs the area with flex workspace on Leman Street and Commercial Road.
avoid_too: Whitechapel deep east — mostly residential, almost no event-capable cafes
Liverpool Street glass towers — too corporate, hard to book for grass-roots dev events
Petticoat Lane street-market alleys — too cramped, no seating for 50+ laptop hackers

neighborhoods.name: Soho / Fitzrovia (W1D / W1T)
neighborhoods.rationale: AI Tinkerers London — the global builder meetup referenced in the prompt — repeatedly convened at Dawn Capital (Manette Street, Soho W1D 4DL) and Phoenix Court (Fitzrovia W1T) in 2025, with single events drawing 500+ applicants and 120+ attendees; Attio in Fitzrovia hosted their March 2025 OpenClaw demo night; the area remains dense with VC-backed event spaces and walkable indie cafes that can be requisitioned for day-long hacking.
avoid_too: Oxford Street retail basements — impossible to book, no daylight
Leicester Square basement bars — tiny, loud, no reliable wifi for demos
West End members-only clubs — too corporate/hospitality-minded, no all-day cafe hacking culture
